_base.description: Scope every analyzer to hand-written first-party code, as golangci-lint saw it: no external repos, Bazel-generated sources, testdata trees (go list ./... skips them), or files with a generated-code header.

exclude_files._gen\\.go$: generated code (oapi-codegen client, command census, metrics census)

storeclass.description: _base's scope with generated files kept in: a _gen.go name or a generated-code header must not take a file the compiler builds out of the storeclass lint, or its rows out of the shrink-only baseline. storeclass skips test files itself.

exclude_files.(^|/)testdata/: fixtures; the baseline generator's ./... never loads them
